name: Four Seasons Oahu at Ko Olina
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on Ko Olina's pristine lagoons, where Hawaiian royalty once vacationed, offering unparalleled luxury just 30 minutes from Honolulu's energy.
whats_special: The resort features Hawaii's only adults-only infinity pool and sits on four man-made lagoons with calm, swimmable waters year-round. The property showcases one of the world's largest collections of contemporary Hawaiian art, and its Naupaka Spa offers treatments using indigenous Hawaiian healing practices passed down through generations.
pro_tip: Book treatments at Naupaka Spa during sunset hours – the ocean-facing treatment rooms offer breathtaking views of the sun melting into the Pacific while you're pampered.
dont_miss: The weekly hukilau ceremony where guests can participate in traditional Hawaiian net fishing, and the nearby Paradise Cove luau featuring authentic Polynesian culture. Ko Olina Marina offers world-class deep-sea fishing, and you're perfectly positioned to witness Hawaii's most spectacular sunsets from Lanikuhonua Beach.
pros: Pristine Ko Olina lagoon location with calm, protected waters ideal for families
Signature Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Multiple world-class dining venues and beach activities
Spacious oceanfront suites with private lanais
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Located on west side, 30 minutes from Honolulu attractions
